name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd
about: Navin Fluorine International Ltd is primary engaged in producing refrigeration gases, inorganic fluorides, specialty organofluorines and offers contract research and manufacturing services. [1] Its portfolio includes 50+ fluorinated compounds developed over the years. [2]

rows.promise: Commissioning of up to 15,000 MTPA R32 HFC capacity by Q3 FY27.
Completion and commissioning of the Chemours Project, initially targeted for Q1 FY27, subsequently revised.
rows.evidence: Chemours Project is progressing well and is on track for completion in Q1 FY27 [Feb 2026 call]. Expected completion was updated to end June/early July [May 2026 call], then end of Q2 FY27 [Aug 2026 call], and Q3 FY27 [Nov 2026 call].

rows.promise: De-bottlenecking of MPP capacity at Dahej facility expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
rows.evidence: De-bottlenecking of MPP capacity at our Dahej facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27 [Feb 2026 call]. Re-confirmed in May 2026 [May 2026 call] and Aug 2026 [Aug 2026 call].

rows.promise: Net working capital expected to be in the range of 75 to 80 days going forward.
rows.evidence: No figure reported after May 2026 yet (latest: 74 days in May 2026, when the promise was made)

rows.promise: Phase 2 cGMP4 capex expected to operationalize by Q4 FY27.
rows.evidence: Phase 2 cGMP4 capex expected to operationalize by Q4 FY '27 [Aug 2026 call]. Re-confirmed for end of Q4 FY27 in Nov 2026 [Nov 2026 call].

rows.promise: Investment in advanced material adoption capacity is expected to commission by Q2 FY28.
rows.evidence: Investment in advanced material adoption capacity is expected to commission by Q2 FY28 [Nov 2026 call].

rows.promise: Meet more than 60% of energy requirements through renewable energy sources.
rows.evidence: Expected to meet more than 60% of our energy requirements through renewable sources [Aug 2026 call]. Re-confirmed in Nov 2026 [Nov 2026 call].

rows.promise: HFO supply contract extension with Solstice Advanced Materials has an additional revenue potential of approximately USD 180 million until December 2032.
rows.evidence: The HFO supply contract extension with Solstice Advanced Materials has an additional revenue potential of approximately USD180 million [Nov 2026 call].

rows.promise: FY27 CDMO target is well within reach, supported by encouraging business developments and healthy product pipeline.
rows.evidence: FY27 target is well within reach, supported by encouraging business developments and healthy product pipeline [Nov 2026 call].

pushback: Sanjesh Jain asked about raw material availability and inflation related to sulfur and methanol due to the Middle East situation.
snapshot: Navin Fluorine International Ltd is a specialty fluorochemicals manufacturer operating across fluorination, CDMO, HFCs, and advanced materials [Feb 2026 call, Nov 2026 call]. Its revenue is driven by Specialty Chemicals, CDMO services, HFO/HFC fluorochemical products, and contract extensions with global partners [Feb 2026 call, Nov 2026 call].

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management promised timely commissioning of the Chemours Project by Q1 FY27 [Feb 2026 call].
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Completion target was pushed sequentially to end of June/July, end of Q2 FY27, and finally Q3 FY27 [May 2026 call, Aug 2026 call, Nov 2026 call].

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management highlights operating leverage driving expanded margins across key segments [Feb 2026 call, Aug 2026 call].
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: EBITDA margin expanded by 8.1 percentage points from 24.5% in FY22 to 32.6% in FY26, reaching 34.2% in Sep 2026 [Computed Facts].

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management promised to keep net working capital days between 75 and 80 days [May 2026 call].
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Working capital days improved significantly to 44 days in FY26 with cash conversion cycle at 60 days [Computed Facts].

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management targets strong CDMO performance supported by Phase 2 cGMP4 capacity [Aug 2026 call, Nov 2026 call].
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Phase 2 cGMP4 operationalization remains scheduled for Q4 FY27 [Aug 2026 call, Nov 2026 call].

bull: Sales CAGR of 22.9% and EBITDA CAGR of 32.0% (FY22–FY26) demonstrate robust top-line and operating leverage growth [Computed Facts].
Cash conversion cycle reduced by 94 days from FY22 to FY26, driving strong cumulative CFO/PAT of 120% [Computed Facts].
Successfully commissioned 15,000 MTPA R32 capacity and secured ~$180M HFO supply contract extension through 2032 [Feb 2026 call, Nov 2026 call].
bear: Chemours project completion has faced repeated timeline slippages from Q1 FY27 out to Q3 FY27 [Feb 2026 call, Nov 2026 call].
Input cost volatility and availability risks exist around raw materials like sulfur and methanol due to Middle East tensions [Analyst Pushback].
Cumulative CFO plus CFI remains negative at -1,442 across FY22–FY26, reflecting heavy ongoing capital expenditure [Computed Facts].
watch: Status of Chemours project commissioning in Q3 FY27 [Nov 2026 call]
Sustainment of EBITDA margins at or near the 34.2% level achieved in Sep 2026 [Computed Facts]
Phase 2 cGMP4 operationalization progress targeted for Q4 FY27 [Nov 2026 call]
